sources.games: 895 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 47.7%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py lifestealer.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Bloodthorn, Butterfly, Black King Bar.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-18: Radiance is enough against illusions, Mjollnir as advice when they are very hard to kill; no Black King Bar against magic (Rage).

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast; high-rank Lifestealers: 36% of 72 games against them (12% otherwise), won 54% against 41%.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Lifestealers buy it against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 27% of 55 games against them (2% otherwise), won 53% against 52%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 48% (5), phase_boots 99% (6), radiance 93% (15), armlet 66% (18), yasha 86% (22), sange 73% (22), sange_and_yasha 54% (23), manta 33% (24), ultimate_scepter 47% (29), buckler 33% (30), basher 62% (31), assault 32% (31), abyssal_blade 35% (37).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where he wins 85.0%+: 25:00 15500 (109 games, 87.2%), 30:00 19000 (144 games, 85.4%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.magic: Rage makes him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance for up to 6 s (Valve 7.41f); against 3+ magic damage heroes his players buy Black King Bar no more often than otherwise (13%).
suppress.illusions: Radiance (93% of his won games, ~15 min) burns the illusions around him; the player review: Radiance is enough, Mjollnir only as a note when they are very hard to kill.

notes.basis: High-rank Lifestealers: Mjollnir 13% of 102 games against them (1% otherwise), won 54% against 49%; Maelstrom 16% of 102 games against them (1% otherwise), won 50% against 50%: the same win rate, so a note after a couple of items, not the next item.

reason.en: {enemy} fights with illusions: Radiance burns them, but if they are still hard to kill, consider Mjollnir after a couple of items
reason.uk: {enemy} б'ється ілюзіями: Radiance їх палить, але якщо їх усе одно важко вбити, після кількох предметів подумайте про Mjollnir
